preference_risk.rationale: “Obesitas” is a common formal or medical Indonesian alternative, though “kegemukan” remains an ordinary everyday choice.

response.rationale: “Kegemukan” is an ordinary Indonesian term for obesity, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses the formal medical term “obesiti.” The pair teaches a useful national usage contrast for the same health-condition sense.
response.risk_rationale: Indonesian “kegemukan” can sometimes suggest general overweight rather than clinically defined obesity in casual usage.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Indonesian also uses “obesitas,” especially in medical or formal contexts, while “kegemukan” is more ordinary and accessible. Malaysian “kegemukan” may be understood, but “obesiti” remains the standard health term, so the contrast is still useful.
